q: What are the best AI growth stocks to watch right now?
a: There is no universal best stock. Start with companies whose business you understand, compare growth with valuation, and consider risks and your time horizon. Our company research pages organize evidence and recent headlines; inclusion is not a buy recommendation.

q: How does Stocks To Buy Now AI calculate market signals?
a: The app brings together company metrics, market context and analytical tools. This website does not publish a complete validated scoring formula. Signals should be assessed with their assumptions and risks rather than treated as certain outcomes.

q: Why did a stock rise or fall today?
a: Check a timestamped quote, company announcements, earnings guidance and sector performance. Several factors may contribute. A headline occurring near a price move does not by itself prove the cause.

q: Are the stock quotes and predictions on this website live?
a: Archived research carries its original date. A live quote must have a data source, timestamp and market-session label; an unlabeled screenshot is not a live quote. Forecasts are uncertain and are not guaranteed prices.

q: What is available publicly and what requires the app?
a: Public pages provide company research guides, article previews, a glossary and any separately published full articles. Subscription research and additional app tools remain available in the app.
